description: The STPU public demonstration of 18 October is real in the ACI account and its demands include an appeal to the President, but no simultaneous turnout estimate is reported. The 450 affected families are impact, not attendees.
required_followup: Find a contemporary independent attendance estimate or another report with a demonstrator count; do not convert workers/families affected into turnout.

description: The Dolisie municipal staff assembly on 10 October is reported as actual, but whether it was public and whether it exceeded 50 attendees are both unknown.
required_followup: Seek follow-up reporting on assembly venue/access, attendee number and any public action after the planned 14 October strike.

description: UMNG strike onset is inconsistent: Adiac says 1 October; later ACI says university activity had been paralyzed since 27 September. No public gathering is established.
required_followup: Check contemporary September notices and October campus reporting; determine onset and whether any public gathering occurred. Do not create a second monthly observation from the same strike.

description: CHU-B, Pointe-Noire municipal and STPU workplace strikes are reported, but the consulted reports generally describe service disruption/negotiations rather than public gatherings; the CHU ACI page body was only partially returned.
required_followup: Search for event-specific public demonstrations/pickets separately from the strike announcements and workplace stoppages; retain body limitations.

description: French searches covered Brazzaville, Pointe-Noire and Dolisie and named Nkayi, Ouesso, Owando, Sibiti and Impfondo, but results concentrated in the two largest cities and Dolisie. Exploratory Lingala/Kituba-like strings were not validated as idiomatic search terms; no sustained local-language press sweep was completed.
required_followup: Use fluent local-language queries and regional/local outlets for northern and interior departments; assess regional press archives.

description: Search outputs are open-web discovery, not a LexisNexis newspaper search; original historical source ledgers were omitted. Receipts show fresh manual_review and stable saved inputs, but cannot establish a clean access inventory or undocumented aliases.
required_followup: Coordinator may supply permitted historical source relationships or baseline context; do not infer permission from no-match. Expand non-held local and regional sources.

description: One initial October four-query discovery call was repeated before its response was separately persisted; the first response is not represented in search_log. The repeated response is captured as Q001, and all subsequent calls were captured. Search count reflects captured records, not every web-tool call.
required_followup: Keep this provenance gap explicit; do not claim search_log contains the unpersisted first call.
